name: visionfix-ai-root
description: VisionFix AI — StressProof diagnosis and source mapping (Phase 2)

scripts.build: npm run --workspace=@visionfix/core build && npm run --workspace=@visionfix/cli build && npm run fixture:build
scripts.typecheck: npm run --workspace=@visionfix/core build && npm run --workspaces --if-present typecheck
scripts.test: npm run build && node --import tsx --test tests/*.test.ts
scripts.test:scan: npm run build && node --import tsx --test tests/scan.test.ts
scripts.test:diagnose: npm run build && node --import tsx --test tests/source-locator.test.ts tests/evidence.test.ts tests/diagnosis-model.test.ts tests/diagnosis-cli.test.ts
